description: An Android Activity demonstrating the use of a SeekBar widget, including handling change events and toggling enable state via a CheckBox.

classes.name: SeekBar1
classes.description: An Activity that demonstrates listening to seek bar changes and controlling UI elements.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and attaches event listeners to UI components.

methods.name: onProgressChanged
methods.description: Updates TextView with the current progress and touch origin status when the seek bar progress changes.

methods.name: onStartTrackingTouch
methods.description: Displays a message indicating that seek bar tracking has started.

methods.name: onStopTrackingTouch
methods.description: Displays a message indicating that seek bar tracking has stopped.
